Student Affairs Services

BUBT International Affairs

Room: [ ], Floor: [ ], Building: [ ], BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Office of International Affairs is newly established, which develops and manages the university’s academic and research relationships with institutions abroad. It negotiates and administers Memoranda of Understanding (MoU), coordinates joint research and grant applications, facilitates student and faculty mobility, and supports international students throughout admission and stay. The Office works to extend BUBT’s mission of academic excellence and research into a recognized global presence.

Services of Our Office

International Student Services

Guiding international applicants on admission, qualification equivalence, visa documentation and supporting them throughout their period of study.

Student Mobility & Exchange

Administering international students at BUBT, student exchange, credit transfer, course equivalence and pre-departure orientation.

International Partnerships & MoU Management

Identifying prospective partner institutions abroad and drafting, processing, and monitoring Memoranda of Understanding and Agreements (MOU) of Cooperation.

International Research Collaboration

Connecting BUBT faculty with counterparts abroad for joint research projects, co-supervision, shared laboratory access, and co-authored publications.

Grants & External Funding

Circulating international funding calls and supporting faculty in preparing proposals for Erasmus+, DAAD, Commonwealth, Fulbright, and similar schemes.

Visiting Scholars & Faculty Exchange

Hosting visiting professors and researchers, processing invitation and clearance documents, and facilitating outbound faculty exchange and conference participation abroad.

Delegations, Events & Global Engagement

Receiving foreign delegations and embassy officials, organizing international seminars and joint webinars, and representing BUBT at global higher education forums.

Internationalization Reporting & Global Visibility

Compiling internationalization data for QS and other ranking submissions and preparing the annual report on international activities for the UGC and BAC.
